localizedValues.name: G1
localizedValues.description:
Vista Group Camp. Primitive group campsite. No electricity. Up to 2 Small RV's or trailers less than 18 feet in length. Limited turn-around area. Tents allowed in large grass area or designated tent pads.
There is a minimum billable party size for this site. The unit price for a block of people may not accurately reflect the total price required. Confirm total payment at checkout.

localizedValues.name: S2-Beach Picnic Shelter
localizedValues.description:
Beach Picnic Shelter - The shelter areas have two covered picnic tables, two uncovered picnic tables and two large BBQ grills. All unsheltered picnic tables are first come, first served.
Groups 20 and over must contact the park at centralwhidbey.permits@parks.wa.gov.

localizedValues.name: S3-Gun Battery Picnic
localizedValues.description:
Gun Battery Picnic Shelter - The shelter areas have two covered picnic tables, two uncovered picnic tables and two large BBQ grills. All unsheltered picnic tables are first come, first served.
Groups 20 and over must contact the park at centralwhidbey.permits@parks.wa.gov.

localizedValues.name: S1-Joseph Whidbey Picnic
localizedValues.description:
Joseph Whidbey Picnic Shelter. Day use park 6 miles north of Fort Ebey State Park. Located off West Beach Road in Oak Harbor.
Groups 20 and over must contact the park at centralwhidbey.permits@parks.wa.gov.
